data.title: About Arnold
bio: Arnold’s hometown is Newark, New Jersey, he grew up in Roselle, NJ where he attended Abraham Clark H. S.  and graduated class of 1980.  Currently he lives in North Brunswick with his wife and 3 daughters.  When she’s not working as a Real Estate Agent, Arnold enjoys playing and coaching basketball, he is a coach to 1st through 12th graders.

He also enjoys golf, gardening, movies, and hanging with his family, friends, and his wifey.  As a Realtor, Arnold loves to meet new people, and helping those people find their dream home is his top priority.  He has been working as a realtor since 2009.  Before COVID, his average number of days from listing to to offer acceptance is 5 days (priced right).  He brings excellent customer service skills, with due diligence and integrity.

In addition to being a realtor, Arnold also worked for the Middlesex County Board of Social Services for 28 years, he retired in 2013.  He has been volunteering with Habitat for Humanity for 3 years, and is currently still actively volunteering.  He learned about the true dynamics of the home building process, and the most important elements of a home.  Call him anytime, he is always available to talk and answer any questions you may have.
